capabilities: Score notes with a 0-100 SEO health grade updating live
Validate frontmatter fields like title, description, slug, and focus keyword
Check heading hierarchy for single H1 and skipped tiers
Compute Flesch reading ease, word count, and keyword density
Audit published live URLs for status, meta tags, and latency
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README lists official links (platform, repository, issue tracker) but the URLs are empty.
problem: Obsidian writers publishing blogs or static sites have no built-in way to check SEO health, heading hierarchy, or readability while drafting.

relations.evidence: An advanced on-page SEO and readability auditing plugin for Obsidian, powered by SEOWebChecker.

summary: SEO audit plugin that scores Markdown notes for on-page SEO, heading structure, readability, keyword usage, and live URL health.
